fixed_on: 2026-11-27 (written to disk before any W7-2 score is computed)
purpose: confirmatory test of layer-17 drift removal on ASVspoof 2019 LA utterances never inspected before
speakers: the 34 test-half speakers of speaker_split(seed 1234); no fit-half speaker
utterances: eval utterances of those speakers that are not in subset.csv (the 1,988 utterances used so far)
sample: 1500 genuine + up to 115 spoofed per attack A07-A19, sampling seed 2027
intervention: subtract v(17) fitted on the original fit half (channel-supervised, both classes); codec-specific for the three damaging stages, the mean of the three for the mild control and clean audio; nothing is refitted or tuned on these data
metrics: EER; real callers rejected and fakes accepted at the clean development threshold; minDCF and DCF_thr (ASVspoof 5 costs); 95% speaker-clustered bootstrap (1,000) for levels and paired differences; per-attack EER
comparisons: uncorrected A, corrected A, checkpoint B and XLSR-SLS on identical trials
